description: Complete an item-by-item review of paper extraction, errata normalization, and the atomic dependency graph.
Run the exact Lean build and review every cited proposition against its atomic rule.
Prove that the padded M_0 output binds the norm terminal to the committed assignment.
Prove that zero-row padding preserves logical CCS and joint PiCCS acceptance.
Prove the paper strong and weak conditions for the padded Nightstream relations.
Instantiate the padded PiCCS extractor and every resulting loss term.
Pin the release source tree, lock file, compiler, target, and verifier binary.
Implement the selected padded-identity joint PiCCS verifier and remove the legacy split branch.
Implement the exact Poseidon2 transcript schedule and bounded strong-set sampler.
Produce the required Rust-origin conformance and mutation suite.
Produce a PaddedRowIdentity manifest for the selected current circuit.
Prove that native acceptance gives an honest satisfying circuit witness.
Prove circuit soundness for every satisfying assignment.
Prove canonical decoding of the circuit public-image tuple and recomputation of its statement digest.
Prove that circuit hints cannot make an invalid assignment accept.
Prove frontend-to-backend circuit lowering for the selected manifest.
Instantiate all security terms for the selected v1 profile.
Check the concrete Module-SIS estimate and the seeded matrix-generation assumption.
Name and instantiate the classical random-oracle Fiat-Shamir theorem.
Prove and compose the exact sampler distribution and bounded exhaustion term.
Prove Rust and circuit refinement against the same normative verifier.
Reduce outer-proof and on-chain acceptance to the selected circuit relation.
Prove fold, session, oracle-query, and extractor composition for the v1 limits.
